verdict.what: a brick-and-stone frontier tavern with a wide open doorway
verdict.style: rustic brick frontier, Old West saloon feel
verdict.summary: The front reads as a tavern with a lit, open door and a nice stone-and-brick base, but the roof is a flat green lid, the side walls are ragged with random orange blocks poking out and holes through them, and the back is a flat slab, so it needs a real roof and a rebuilt side and back before anyone places it.
